title: #74 slice 5: first use, and the end of relayed verdicts
body:
Implements [§10.5 and §11.4 of the design](docs/design/74-external-review.md). Part of #74; depends on slice 4.

- Review a real out-of-band PR with `@swarm review` and merge it only on its `external_review_judged` verdict.
- From then on, **every merge to `main` either comes through `@swarm` or carries an `external_review_judged` event for its exact head SHA.** No exemptions (§11.4).
- Document the rule where merges are recorded, and close #58 once the first ledger-native external verdict has gated a merge.
